title: Fix a broken compose.yaml
summary: Somebody's compose.yaml for the notes app won't even start. Find the three mistakes without touching the code.

tasks.title: Compose can read `compose.yaml`
tasks.hint: `docker compose config` names a line, but YAML errors are reported near the problem, not always on it. Look at the whole block it points at: is every line in a list lined up with the others? Count the spaces.

tasks.title: `http://localhost:3504` opens, with no red error
tasks.hint: Nothing answers? `docker compose logs web` says which port the app listens on inside; the right side of `ports:` must be that. "api can't reach the database: ENOTFOUND"? `DB_HOST` must be a **service name** from this file.

tasks.title: You saved a note, and it shows in the list
tasks.hint: Open http://localhost:3504, write a note, press Save.

tasks.title: The code is unchanged
tasks.hint: All three mistakes are in `compose.yaml`. If you changed `web/server.js` or `api/server.js`, put them back (Reset gives you fresh files).
